Expert MINOR deferred: rank_codes.py cannot represent a cashback rate, card benefit, or gift-card discount, so it cannot rank the lever the skill repeatedly says usually beats the code. Either extend it to score effective saving across lever types or drop it.

Provenance carry: benefits.isracard.co.il and cal-online.co.il/benefits are hard WAF blocks (Cloudflare 403 and F5 400) to curl AND to headless Chromium. Their existence is cross-checked by search, not by reading the page; both evidence entries are confidence=medium. Re-verify from a real browser next cycle.

Judge lesson for future cycles: the first draft of the foreign-marketplace jurisdiction gate said Israeli consumer law 'does not reach' foreign sellers. That is legally overstated. RAA 5860/16 Facebook v. Ben Hamo let an Israeli consumer sue a foreign company in Israel despite a foreign-jurisdiction clause (applying California substantive law). The correct framing is practical unenforceability against a small overseas seller, not absence of the right.

The link sweep was clean, and saying so is a result. Every named destination was checked by navigation with a per-host fabricated-path control; two hosts (isracard, cal-online) return WAF bodies byte-identical for real and fake paths, so only a browser can tell them apart and a status-code sweep would have called both dead.
The real defects were in the script, not the links. A validator-shaped tool that accepts unknown keys and renders a table of dashes looks finished and recommends a candidate it knows nothing about.
The doc said "date" and the code read "date_seen". A one-word schema mismatch is invisible to every gate and produces exactly the empty-column output an agent will not question.

Deferred: rank_codes.py takes expiry as free text inside conditions, so nothing mechanically filters an expired code. That is defensible as a formatting tool, but the description promises expiry checking, so either the schema should carry a real date field or the description should be explicit that the agent does that check.

Destination re-check found one live source drift: Kol-Zchut dropped email from the 4-month precondition ('phone or chat'). Status-code sweeps cannot see a wording change; snippet re-slicing in a real browser did.

A vendor's TERMS page is a source too. cashback.co.il/terms s.19 says another site's coupon, a later-paid saved cart, or a technical tracking failure voids the rebate. The skill had told shoppers to stack a code on a cashback visit for three cycles without it.

The payment line overpromised a chargeback. The statutory credit-transaction right (Kol-Zchut) only stops REMAINING installments on non-delivery; it refunds nothing already paid. Do not reintroduce 'chargeback stays available' wording anywhere, including enriched FAQ.
The parcel-SMS warning contradicted the skill's own customs source (couriers DO notify tax by SMS/email). A scam heuristic stated as an absolute rule is a factual claim and needs a source.
